S4A-2026-000.candidate_fi: Tukea antavan ja palliatiivisen hoidon tunnusmerkkityökalu (SPICT-4ALL-……)
S4A-2026-000.decision_note: Instrument title. SPICT-4ALL and the two-ellipsis language-suffix placeholder are kept verbatim, including the digit 4. 'Indicators Tool' is rendered as a tool of tunnusmerkit without adding a screening or needs-assessment claim.

issues.note: S4A-2026-000 has final_inclusion_status UNRESOLVED and eligible_for_document_insertion false in the frozen evidence contract. Authoritative final title wording awaits Stage 6A source-authority disposition. This candidate is translation evidence only.

'Supportive care' has no approved Finnish project term. 'tukea antava hoito' keeps a plain descriptive reading; 'tukihoito' would pull toward oncology supportive treatment and may be narrower than the SPICT sense. Human decision required.

S4A-2026-001.candidate_fi: SPICT auttaa meitä etsimään ihmisiä, joilla on elinikää lyhentäviä terveydentiloja ja joiden terveydentila on heikentynyt. Nämä ihmiset tarvitsevat nyt enemmän apua ja hoitoa sekä suunnitelman tulevaa hoitoa varten.
S4A-2026-001.decision_note: Applies T-002. First-person plural 'helps us' kept as 'auttaa meitä'. Present need for help and care is kept distinct from a plan for future care. 'less well' is a comparative state, not a terminal phase.

S4A-2026-002.candidate_fi: Onko tällä henkilöllä merkkejä huonosta terveydentilasta tai terveysongelmia, jotka pahenevat?
S4A-2026-002.decision_note: Question form preserved. The two alternatives (signs of poor health / health problems) are kept separate.

issues.note: 'that are getting worse' can attach to 'health problems' alone or to both alternatives. Finnish follows the nearest-antecedent reading and attaches it to 'terveysongelmia'. The source ambiguity is flagged, not resolved.

S4A-2026-003.candidate_fi: Kiireellinen tai päivystyksellinen sairaalaan otto(t) tai käynnit.
S4A-2026-003.decision_note: 'urgent' and 'emergency' kept as two alternatives. The source's '(s)' optional-plural marker is mirrored with Finnish '(t)'. Singular-or-plural admissions and already-plural visits are not collapsed.

S4A-2026-004.candidate_fi:
Toimintakyky on heikentynyt tavanomaisissa toimissa; ei ole yhtä hyvässä kunnossa kuin ennen.
(Henkilö on usein vuoteessa tai tuolissa yli puolet päivästä.)
S4A-2026-004.decision_note: Line break, semicolon and parenthetical clarification preserved. Comparative loss of ability is not turned into inability. 'usual activities' is left general. The comparison is to the person's own earlier state.

S4A-2026-005.candidate_fi: Tarvitsee enemmän apua ja hoitoa muilta lisääntyvien ruumiillisten ja/tai mielenterveyden ongelmien vuoksi.
S4A-2026-005.decision_note: 'and/or' kept as 'ja/tai'. Causal 'due to' preserved. 'from others' is left unspecified as to who provides the help.

S4A-2026-006.candidate_fi: Henkilöä hoitava läheinen tarvitsee enemmän apua ja tukea.
S4A-2026-006.decision_note: 'carer' rendered descriptively as the close person who cares for them, without assigning a Finnish statutory caregiver status. 'help' and 'support' kept as two needs.

issues.note: T-003: no approved Finnish term for 'carer'. 'omaishoitaja' would add a Finnish informal-care agreement status the source does not state; 'hoitaja' would overlap professional staff. Descriptive rendering used. Human decision required.

S4A-2026-007.candidate_fi: On selvästi laihtunut muutaman viime kuukauden aikana; tai pysyy liian laihana.
S4A-2026-007.decision_note: The source's '; or' punctuation is kept. Recent clear weight loss and remaining too thin are separate alternatives. 'stays' is ongoing.

S4A-2026-008.candidate_fi: Hankalia oireita on suurimman osan ajasta, vaikka terveysongelmia hoidetaan hyvin.
S4A-2026-008.decision_note: Concessive 'despite' kept. 'good treatment' is treatment being given well, not a good outcome. 'most of the time' is frequency, not constancy.

S4A-2026-009.candidate_fi: Henkilö (tai perhe) pyytää palliatiivista hoitoa; valitsee hoidon vähentämisen, lopettamisen tai ottamatta jättämisen; tai haluaa keskittyä elämänlaatuun.
S4A-2026-009.decision_note: Person-or-family agency kept. The three treatment choices (reduce / stop / not have) remain distinct. Semicolon segmentation preserved. 'saattohoito' is not used.

S4A-2026-010.candidate_fi: Onko tällä henkilöllä jokin näistä terveysongelmista?
S4A-2026-010.decision_note: Question form preserved. 'any of these' is at least one of the listed problems.

S4A-2026-011.decision_note: Column heading. No terminal punctuation in the source; none added.

S4A-2026-012.decision_note: Column heading. Heart and circulation kept as alternatives. No terminal punctuation added.

S4A-2026-013.decision_note: Column heading. No terminal punctuation added.

S4A-2026-014.candidate_fi: Toimintakyky on heikentynyt tavanomaisissa toimissa, ja terveys heikkenee.
S4A-2026-014.decision_note: Same 'less able to manage usual activities' phrasing as S4A-2026-004, without turning it into inability. Coordinating 'and' is not made causal.

S4A-2026-015.candidate_fi: Sydämen vajaatoiminta tai sydämen verisuonisairaus. Hengenahdistusta tai rintakipua levossa, liikkuessa tai muutamaa askelta kävellessä.
S4A-2026-015.decision_note: 'heart blood vessel disease' kept in the source's plain register; 'sepelvaltimotauti' is not used because it would narrow the meaning. Two symptoms and three activity states are preserved.

S4A-2026-016.candidate_fi: Munuaiset eivät toimi hyvin; yleinen terveys heikkenee.
S4A-2026-016.decision_note: Negation and semicolon segmentation preserved. 'general health' is kept broader than the kidney problem.

S4A-2026-017.candidate_fi: Ei ole riittävän hyväkuntoinen syöpähoitoon, tai hoito on oireiden helpottamiseksi.
S4A-2026-017.decision_note: Two alternatives kept: not well enough for cancer treatment, or the treatment given is to help with symptoms. Neither is presented as following from the other.

S4A-2026-018.candidate_fi: Jalkaongelmia huonon verenkierron vuoksi; leikkaus ei ole mahdollinen.
S4A-2026-018.decision_note: Causal 'due to' and negated possibility preserved. Plain register kept; 'inoperaabeli' is not used.

S4A-2026-019.candidate_fi: Munuaisdialyysin lopettaminen tai palliatiivisen hoidon valitseminen dialyysin aloittamisen sijaan.
S4A-2026-019.decision_note: Both alternatives preserved, including choosing palliative care instead of starting dialysis. Choosing agency is kept in 'valitseminen'.

S4A-2026-020.decision_note: Stopping an ongoing treatment and not starting one are kept distinct. No terminal punctuation in the source; none added.

S4A-2026-021.decision_note: Two named conditions kept as alternatives. The source word 'dementia' is kept as the same Finnish loanword rather than broadened to muistisairaus. No terminal punctuation added.

issues.note: T-009: 'frailty' has no approved Finnish project term. 'hauraus' stays in a plain register but is vaguer than the clinical concept; 'hauraus-raihnausoireyhtymä' and 'gerastenia' would raise the register and may add an age limit the source does not state. Human decision required.

S4A-2026-022.decision_note: Column heading. No terminal punctuation added.

S4A-2026-023.decision_note: Column heading. No terminal punctuation added.

S4A-2026-024.candidate_fi: Ei pysty pukeutumaan, kävelemään tai syömään ilman apua.
S4A-2026-024.decision_note: Inability and the three activities kept as alternatives. 'without help' is kept, so the statement is about needing help rather than total inability.

S4A-2026-025.candidate_fi: Vointi on huonompi pitkäaikaisten keuhko-ongelmien yhteydessä. Hengenahdistusta levossa, liikkuessa tai muutamaa askelta kävellessä silloinkin, kun rintakehä on parhaimmillaan.
S4A-2026-025.decision_note: Three activity states and the concessive 'even when' are preserved so breathlessness is not limited to a bad period. 'long term' kept as pitkäaikainen.

issues.note: 'the chest is at its best' is English plain-language idiom. Rendered as the chest/rib cage being at its best. A Finnish reviewer should confirm the intended baseline-breathing sense.

S4A-2026-026.candidate_fi: Maksaongelmat ovat pahentuneet kuluneen vuoden aikana lisäongelmien kanssa, kuten:
S4A-2026-026.decision_note: 'complications' kept plain as 'lisäongelmia' rather than 'komplikaatioita'. Time window 'in the past year' and the non-exhaustive 'like:' colon are preserved.

S4A-2026-027.decision_note: List item; lowercase start and no terminal punctuation preserved. 'belly' kept plain as 'vatsa'; 'askites' is not used.

S4A-2026-028.decision_note: List item; lowercase start and no terminal punctuation preserved. 'at times' is intermittent, not continuous.

S4A-2026-029.decision_note: List item repeating the kidney-function wording of S4A-2026-016, in lowercase list form without terminal punctuation.

S4A-2026-030.decision_note: List item; lowercase start and no terminal punctuation preserved.

S4A-2026-031.decision_note: List item; lowercase start and no terminal punctuation preserved. 'gullet' is the plain word for the oesophagus; 'ruokatorvi' is ordinary Finnish.

S4A-2026-032.decision_note: Reduced eating and drinking kept separate from swallowing difficulty, matching the semicolon.

S4A-2026-033.candidate_fi: Tarvitsee käyttää happea suuren osan päivästä ja yöstä.
S4A-2026-033.decision_note: Both day and night preserved. 'needs to use' is kept as needing to use, not merely needing oxygen. 'much of' is a large part, not all of the time.

S4A-2026-034.candidate_fi: Virtsarakon ja suolen hallinta on heikkoa.
S4A-2026-034.decision_note: 'poor control' is reduced control, not absent control. Both organs are named rather than replaced by a continence label.

S4A-2026-035.decision_note: Applies T-013 (hengityskone). Hospital setting and completed past need are preserved. No device type, invasiveness or lasting dependence is added.

S4A-2026-036.candidate_fi: Ei pysty kommunikoimaan puhumalla; ei vastaa juurikaan muihin ihmisiin.
S4A-2026-036.decision_note: Both negations kept separate. 'by speaking' is preserved, so other channels are not excluded. 'not responding much' is partial, not total unresponsiveness.

S4A-2026-037.decision_note: Recurrent falls and the named femur fracture kept as in the source. 'reisiluu' is the ordinary Finnish word for femur.

S4A-2026-038.decision_note: No terminal punctuation in the source; none added. Recurrence applies to infections and is not extended to pneumonia.

S4A-2026-039.decision_note: Column heading. No terminal punctuation added.

S4A-2026-040.decision_note: Column heading. 'conditions' aligned with the noun used in T-002 ('terveydentila') without applying that decision here. No terminal punctuation added.

S4A-2026-041.decision_note: Physical and mental health kept as two named domains, both worsening.

S4A-2026-042.candidate_fi: Ihmiset, joiden terveydentila on heikentynyt ja joilla on muita elinikää lyhentäviä ruumiillisia tai henkisiä sairauksia tai terveydentiloja. Hoitoa ei ole saatavilla, tai se ei tehoa hyvin.
S4A-2026-042.decision_note: Applies T-002. 'other' marks these as additional conditions. No-treatment-available and treatment-will-not-work-well kept as separate alternatives. Illnesses and health conditions kept as two nouns.

S4A-2026-043.candidate_fi: Enemmän ongelmia puhumisessa ja kommunikoinnissa; nieleminen vaikeutuu.
S4A-2026-043.decision_note: Speaking and communicating kept as two named areas. Swallowing is presented as getting worse over time.

S4A-2026-044.candidate_fi: Mitä voimme tehdä tämän henkilön ja hänen perheensä auttamiseksi.
S4A-2026-044.decision_note: First-person plural agency kept. Both the person and their family are those helped. Source period is kept; this is not turned into a question.

S4A-2026-045.decision_note: Three items kept with the source semicolon: chest infections, pneumonia, breathing problems.

issues.note: 'chest infections' rendered as infections of the chest/rib-cage area to stay close to the source noun. Finnish everyday wording more often says hengitystieinfektio, which may be broader. Reviewer should confirm the intended scope.

S4A-2026-046.candidate_fi: Aloita keskustelu henkilön ja hänen perheensä tai häntä hoitavan läheisen kanssa siitä, millaista apua nyt tarvitaan ja miksi suunnitelmien tekeminen on tärkeää sen varalta, että asiat muuttuvat.
S4A-2026-046.decision_note: Staff-directed imperative kept. Present help, the reason for making plans, and the conditional 'in case things change' are three distinct elements. Same descriptive rendering of 'carer' as S4A-2026-006.

issues.note: T-003: no approved Finnish term for 'carer'; the same descriptive rendering as S4A-2026-006 is used. Human decision required and should be consistent across both units.

S4A-2026-047.candidate_fi: Jatkuva toimintarajoite, johon liittyy lisääntyviä ruumiillisia ja/tai mielenterveyden ongelmia yhden tai useamman aivohalvauksen jälkeen.
S4A-2026-047.decision_note: 'and/or' kept as 'ja/tai'. 'one or more strokes' kept as a count alternative. Time order 'after' preserved.

issues.note: 'ongoing disability' rendered as continuing functional limitation. 'vamma' or 'vammaisuus' could read as a disability-status claim the source does not make. Reviewer should confirm.

S4A-2026-048.candidate_fi: Pyydä apua ja neuvoa sairaanhoitajalta, lääkäriltä, sosiaalityöntekijältä tai muulta henkilökunnalta, jos henkilö tai perhe tarvitsee hoitonsa ja tukensa tarkastelua.
S4A-2026-048.decision_note: Four staff alternatives kept, including open-ended 'other staff'. Imperative, conditional trigger, and the pairing of care and support are preserved.

S4A-2026-049.candidate_fi: Tarkastelemme henkilön lääkkeitä ja muita hoitoja, jotta voimme antaa parasta hoitoa. Kokonaisvaltaiseen hoitoon kuuluvat oireet sekä tunne-elämän, sosiaaliset, toimintakykyyn liittyvät, taloudelliset, hengelliset ja kulttuuriset ongelmat.
S4A-2026-049.decision_note: Applies T-016. First-person plural agency kept. All seven listed domains remain visible: symptoms, emotional, social, functional, financial, spiritual, cultural. The source mix of a noun ('symptoms') with adjectives is not silently repaired.

issues.note: T-018 was closed as not requiring a pre-G1 term. 'hengelliset' can lean religious in Finnish, while English 'spiritual' may include existential concerns. Carried as a note for synthesis and human review.

S4A-2026-050.candidate_fi: Pyydä asiantuntija-apua, jos oireita tai ongelmia on vaikea hallita.

issues.note: 'specialist help' rendered as asiantuntija-apua. 'erikoislääkäri' would narrow it to physicians and a Finnish special-level palliative-care tier would add a service level the source does not name.

S4A-2026-051.candidate_fi: Hoitosuunnitelmat jaetaan henkilökunnalle, jonka tarvitsee nähdä ne, ja ne pidetään ajan tasalla.
S4A-2026-051.decision_note: Sharing is limited to staff who need to see the plans, and the plans are kept up to date. Both obligations are preserved.

S4A-2026-052.decision_note: Instrument name and year identifier retained verbatim, including the en dash, spacing, digit 4 and 2026 version marker.
